thread:
incident-bot: PAGE: P1 - Customer Borealis reporting widespread 401s from their VPC identity proxy (dedicated pool). Affected routes: /v1/auth/*, /v1/token. Error spike began ~02:12 UTC. Please respond ASAP. @sre-oncall

maria-iraola: on it. can someone grab the pool logs and jwks trace?

adrian-k: i'm pulling logs from the dedicated pool now. seeing a flood of `401 invalid_token` from the identity-proxy component. upstream JWKS fetch to https://borealis.example/.well-known/jwks.json returns 200 but the KIDs in the keys list don't match tokens we see.

leo: borealis mentioned they rolled keys as part of scheduled rotation 02:10 UTC — @borealis-sre can you confirm what rotated? cert vs jwks vs tenant keystore?

borealis-sre: we rolled both tenant signing key and the proxy's client cert at ~02:08. The new provider jwks has a new kid `kid:kb-rot-2026` — we didn't change token issuer. We'll paste the jwks shortly. Sorry for the hit, we're investigating too.

jordana: quick mitigation idea: we can add a temporary allowlist for the old kid in the identity-proxy so existing tokens keep validating while customers rotate. Do we have that control plane knob for this customer?

maria-iraola: yes, we have a per-tenant `allowed_kids` override in the proxy config. ops runbook says: 
```json
{"identity_proxy": {"allowed_kids": ["<kid>"]}}
```
we can push it via the private control plane for Borealis.

adrian-k: i tried a manual JWKS fetch from their origin: `curl -sS https://borealis.example/.well-known/jwks.json | jq .keys[].kid` returns only `kb-rot-2026` — old kid not present. tokens hitting us are older ones signed with `kb-old-2025`.

ops-bot: NOTE: deploying per-tenant override requires a short config rollout to the private control plane. This will touch 1 node in Borealis' dedicated control-plane agent and will not affect other tenants. ETA ~2m for rollout.

maria-iraola: i'm going to stage the override with the old kid `kb-old-2025` and push to Borealis tenant. Will monitor auth success.

borealis-sre: we can also re-publish the old kid to the jwks endpoint as a quick rollback if you prefer — we retained the private key. Would you prefer us to flip their jwks back?

leo: prefer control-plane short-term change (safer for us), ask customer to republish as follow-up. maria, please push the override and confirm logs.

maria-iraola: pushing now. command: 
```bash
# control-plane: set allowed_kids for tenant borealis
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"identity_proxy":{"allowed_kids":["kb-old-2025"]}}' \
  https://private-controlplane.internal/tenants/borealis/config
```

maria-iraola: pushed. ops-bot shows rollout started.

ops-bot: Rollout status: 1/1 agents updated. Validation passed.

adrian-k: seeing auth success rate climb from 12% -> 98% in proxy logs. replacing tokens that fail are dropping off. great.

borealis-sre: confirming — our app logs show upstream 200s again. We'll leave the old key published as a fallback for 24 hours then rotate.

jordana: nice. action items: 1) keep override for 24h, 2) customer to push jwks with old kid or rotate clients, 3) schedule postmortem for key rotation process. Anyone want to own the postmortem?

leo: i'll own postmortem writeup (inc. deployment safeguards + runbook tweak). maria, add the config change to incident timeline and include diffs.

maria-iraola: added timeline and diffs to the thread. snippet of what we applied: 
```json
{"applied_at":"2026-03-15T02:16:00Z","tenant":"borealis","change":{"identity_proxy":{"allowed_kids":["kb-old-2025"]}}}
```

adrian-k: note for the postmortem: our JWKS caching layer currently caches jwks for 15m; customer rotated at 02:08 and origin only had new kid. sequence: token issuance window + JWKS propagation race + client refresh window = failures. we'll recommend short-lived overlap windows.

borealis-sre: thanks team. we'll also add an automated test to our rotation pipeline to verify token validation against a mirror of your proxy before rolling.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: customer-reported impact mitigated; auth success restored to >98%. Severity scaled down to S3. Please follow normal postmortem cadence.

sre-oncall: ack. handing to night oncall @adrian-k-night at 23:00 UTC for overnight watch and to ensure override is removed only when both sides confirm.

adrian-k: i'll be on overnight. plan: at 02:16 +24h we will: 1) confirm jwks contains `kb-old-2025` or client rotated; 2) remove `allowed_kids` override; 3) monitor auth rates for 30m. if regressions, re-apply and escalate.

jordana: tagging follow-ups: `#postmortem` owner=leo, `#runbook` owner=maria-iraola, `#customer-coord` owner=borealis-sre.

maria-iraola: quick note for the postmortem: consider adding a control-plane API safety check that refuses per-tenant override removal if there's any active tokens signed by removed kids in the last X minutes — saves a class of these races.

borealis-sre: agreed, we'll coordinate a test for that. thanks for fast response. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated) — archived to incidents log.
